chunks: And Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said:

Regarding a woman who claimed that she menstruated three menstrual cycles in one month: women from her close circle should be asked whether her menstruation in the past was according to what she claimed. If they testify, she is to be believed; otherwise, she is lying.

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman, the subject of the legal ruling
key_terms.بِطَانَتِهَا: her close circle, women familiar with her condition
key_terms.صُدِّقَتْ: she is deemed truthful and believed
key_terms.كَاذِبَةٌ: a liar; her claim is rejected

ai.seo_question: How is a woman's claim of having three menstrual cycles in one month verified in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who claims to have had three menstrual cycles within a single month. Her claim is evaluated by asking women familiar with her previous pattern; if they confirm it, her statement is accepted, otherwise it is rejected.
